items.title: Lionel Ferbos Interview, 1964-08-03
items.q: Remember Schmidty sang and I played the sweet solo on it.

ctx.x: Not that I know of, but I already recorded with Cheetah on it, but I never did hear it.

Yeah, that woman in love, who was on that recording that was playing at a store one day, just about three days after that fellow there that night, we made him cut the tape record off, but he had already got the woman in love. Remember Schmidty sang and I played the sweet solo on it.

And then I mean, I'm talking about that Happy Land in 2 there. So I was coming there with the, you used to come out there quite often there. And we had, but this was a new bunch. I had never seen all the equipment for Eddie, but I didn't have an idea it was a tape recorder. It looked like it was mostly taking pictures. But Eddie Dawson said he saw the red light going on, but it must have been a very compact deal. Yeah. So dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear…
